estimate_type: weighted project-management estimate; not scientific-performance measurement

workstreams.name: Data foundation, Network 1 and classical baseline
workstreams.evidence: Existing Network 1 validation, saved split definitions and row-capped classical baseline metrics.

workstreams.name: Network 2 mapping and both 14-shard extractions
workstreams.evidence: Local extracted tables: 1,739,224 source-specific rows and 1,633,220 overall-direct rows across 2,295 mapped targets and 21,268 diseases.

workstreams.name: Joint Network 2 data-backed validation
workstreams.evidence: Local rerun on 2026-11-21: all 17 critical checks true, zero warnings, zero mapping mismatches, duplicate keys or invalid score values.

workstreams.name: Router, Europe PMC client, four strategies, annotation/evaluator implementation
workstreams.evidence: Merged implementation; local pytest run: 70 passed, 1 deselected.

workstreams.name: Actual fixed-candidate and live retrieval run
workstreams.evidence: Nine label-blind candidates generated and first live four-arm retrieval executed. Fifteen candidate-strategy-publication records returned with two timeouts, but all records were disease-context and coverage was low; query refinement and a defensible follow-up retrieval run remain.

workstreams.name: Human evidence annotations
workstreams.evidence: No human SUPPORT, CONTRADICT or UNKNOWN annotations completed; all 15 initial retrieval records remain UNANNOTATED.

workstreams.name: Matched-policy evaluation and final results
workstreams.evidence: Evaluator code exists, but no complete annotation set or measured four-arm comparison has been produced.

interpretation: 80% measures completion of the defined engineering-plus-pilot workflow. It does not mean the broader research programme is complete, retrieval policy effectiveness is established, human evidence labels are complete or the scientific hypothesis has been validated.
